verdict.rationale: GitLab's documentation has a dedicated "Get started with Git" section for working with the Git version control system, which is a first-party resource for learning Git. The evidence is only a section heading and one-line description, so the depth and scope of the learning material is not shown. Missing for 10: details of the tutorial or learning content (basic concepts, commands, branching and merging guides), evidence of in-product (not just docs-site) learning aids, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its usefulness.
